items.title: Enabling a new model for healthcare with AI co-clinician
items.summary: Researching the path to AI-augmented care and development of an AI co-clinician.
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind宣布启动AI辅助临床医生（AI co-clinician）研究计划，旨在探索AI Agent如何在临床监督下与医生协作，通过“三元护理”模式提升医疗服务效率，解决全球医疗专家短缺问题。

items.title: Introducing Advanced Account Security
items.summary: Introducing Advanced Account Security: phishing-resistant login, stronger recovery, and enhanced protections to safeguard sensitive data and prevent account takeover.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于账户安全性的更新，包括防钓鱼登录和增强的恢复机制。此更新旨在保护用户敏感数据，与大模型核心技术研发无关。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容属于通用账户安全更新，与大模型技术本身无直接关联。
